$comment: GENERATED by scripts/gen/contracts.gen.mjs (npm run gen). Do not edit. A diff here means the wire contract changed: update docs/spec/PROTOCOL.md too.

acceptSuggestion.summary: Accepts an offered HQ suggestion (such as S0 Establish Colony or an early-stage rule suggestion, UO-LC-04 / UO-LC-05).

attackMove.summary: Orders one or more owned combat units to advance to (q, r), engaging hostile targets along the way (W07-12).

attackTarget.summary: Orders one or more owned combat units to pursue and attack a specific target entity or hive (W07-12).

bounty.claim.summary: Registers this colony as a claimer of an open bounty.

bounty.paid.summary: Credits the claimer after `EscrowPort.claim` pays the bounty reward.

bounty.post.summary: Posts a bounty (clear a nest, defend an area, or deliver Tier-1 cargo) with a reward held in escrow until `expiresAt`.

cancelGoal.summary: Cancels an active or queued HQ goal and removes its waiting child orders from the order queue (UO-P §4.6).

cancelTask.summary: Cancels a queued or in-progress order (refunds 75 % if in progress and cancels linked prep, UO-Q-02 / UO-TF-03).

cargo.export.summary: Exports `amount` whole units of `resource` from colony stock to orbital NEP-245 custody via an online Trade Hub (W10-01, NEAR-50).

cargo.import.summary: Imports `amount` whole units of `resource` from orbital NEP-245 custody into colony stock via an online Trade Hub (W10-01, NEAR-51).

cargo.settled.summary: Module command from the NEAR outbox relay settling an export or import (`ok:true` finalises; `ok:false` refunds or releases reservation, W10-07 / W10-12).

demolish.summary: Demolishes an owned finished structure and refunds 50 % of its cost while keeping tiles Prepared (UO-Q-02, W02-09).

dev.addload.summary: Dev console: injects synthetic electrical load (E/s) onto a colony or specific pylon branch (W03-27).

dev.autopilot.summary: Dev command to inspect or step the HQ rule-engine decision (`autopilot next`).

dev.cargoCapReset.summary: Dev console (`cargo.cap.reset <colony>`): clears the rolling 60 s and UTC-day cargo mint counters for the colony (W10-26).

dev.cargoGrant.summary: Dev console (`cargo.grant <colony> <res> <amt>`): grants or adjusts in-orbit cargo balance for the colony (W10-26).

dev.cell.summary: Dev console: sets the colony HQ power cell energy to `energy` (clamped to cell capacity).

dev.contactFake.summary: Dev console (`contact.fake`): fakes neighbour/Guild contact on the colony so Trade Hub unlock can be tested below Stage 5 (W10-03).

dev.damage.summary: Dev console: damages an entity by `pct` percent of its max HP (clamped above 1 HP unless pct >= 100, W03-27).

dev.drainfuel.summary: Dev console: zeroes the colony biomass stock (`bio.biomass`) to test Thermal Plant fuel starvation (W03-27).

dev.faunamode.summary: Dev console (`faunaMode` / `faunaTarget`): switches a hive or bug between passive and aggressive mode and/or retargets it (W07-29).

dev.fill.summary: Dev console: fills a resource (or family / all T1 resources) up to its colony family storage cap, or sets it to `amount` when provided (clamped to cap, W02-30).

dev.goal.summary: Dev command to add, cancel, or clear HQ goals (`goal add <type>`).

dev.godmode.summary: Dev console (`godMode`): toggles or sets damage immunity for the colony (W07-29).

dev.grant.summary: Dev console: adds (positive) or withdraws (negative) `amount` whole units of `resource` on the caller colony via the ledger (`dev.grant`); a withdrawal is clamped to the balance so stock stays >= 0.

dev.killHq.summary: Dev console: destroys the target colony HQ Drone (`UO-HQ-04`, W18-25).

dev.killHub.summary: Dev console: destroys the target colony Command Hub (`UO-HQ-04`, W18-25).

dev.land.summary: Dev console: respawns or lands the caller colony drop pod and HQ at a spawn slot.

dev.lightning.summary: Dev console: triggers a 4-hex lightning strike that heavily damages targets, overloads electricity, and puts damaged buildings offline temporarily (W05).

dev.meteor.summary: Dev console: triggers a meteor impact that destroys all entities in a 10-hex blast zone and leaves TERRAIN.hole craters (W05).

dev.nudge.summary: Moves a test entity by dev.probe.nudgeTiles tiles along (dq, dr); default direction +q.

dev.offerTruce.summary: Dev console: injects a truce offer from a neighbor colony into the player colony (`UO-DIP-02`, W18-25).

dev.ping.summary: No-op command that round-trips through the sim; acked with the tick it was applied at.

dev.power.summary: Dev console: dumps or overrides the colony power grid component balance and shed states (W02-30, W10-30).

dev.rain.summary: Dev console: sets planet rain level (none, minor, heavy) and intensity (0..1) (W05).

dev.reveal.summary: Dev console: marks every tile explored for the caller colony.

dev.seed.summary: Dev console: regenerates the dev planet terrain with the given seed.

dev.setShield.summary: Dev console: sets newcomer raid protection (`raidProtectedUntil`) on a colony for `hours` hours (`UO-T-05`, W18-25).

dev.setwind.summary: Dev console: sets the planet wind speed factor percentage (e.g. 50..140, W03-27).

dev.skipnight.summary: Dev console: advances the planet clock to sunrise if currently in night (W02-30).

dev.spawn.summary: Inserts the W00 test entity (kind 1) at tile (q, r); x/y are the tile centre in axial float coordinates.

dev.spawndeposit.summary: Dev console: places a full resource deposit of `family` and `tier` on tile `(q, r)`, like a terraform find (`terraformFinds.deposit.richnessBp`).

dev.spawnhive.summary: Dev console (`spawnHive`): spawns a 3x3 species hive and its initial resident bugs at (q, r) (W07-29).

dev.spawnraid.summary: Dev console (`spawnRaid`): provokes a species hive and dispatches a bounded raid wave against the colony (W07-29).

dev.spawnunit.summary: Dev console (`spawnUnit` / `spawn builder|harvester`): spawns colony combat/worker units or neutral fauna bugs at (q, r) (W07-29, W13-57).

dev.stage.summary: Dev command to set colony stage (`set`), skip stage dwell timer (`skip-dwell`), or trigger a safety override (`trigger`).

dev.storm.summary: Dev console: toggles or configures storm + rain + lightning weather state on the planet (W05).

dev.teleport.summary: Sets a test entity position directly to tile (q, r).

dev.time.summary: Dev command to configure the planet time of day (0..24h or `day`/`night`/`hh:mm`), real hours per day, and time scale without requiring a seated colony.

dev.tradehubSpawn.summary: Dev console (`tradehub.spawn`): spawns an instant completed online Trade Hub for the caller colony (W10-26).

dev.twister.summary: Dev console: spawns a rising twister that travels in a random direction, damages buildings, and sucks up units and trees (requires high wind and minor rain, W05).

diplomacy.cancelTruce.summary: Starts the 10-minute cancellation notice on an active truce and marks the canceller Oathbreaker for 24 h (`UO-DIP-04`, W18-01, W18-14).

diplomacy.proposeTruce.summary: Proposes a fixed-term bilateral truce (2 / 6 / 24 / 72 h) to a contacted colony (`UO-DIP-01..02`, W18-01, W18-11..12).

diplomacy.respondTruce.summary: Accepts or declines an incoming truce offer before its 10-minute expiry (`UO-DIP-02`, W18-01, W18-12).

enqueueTask.summary: Enqueues a terraform order (W01), a building construction order (W02), a unit production order (W02), a repair / HQ-goal order (W03), a prestige project order (W13), or a PvP raid order (W18) in the colony queue.

landPod.summary: Opens the caller colony's descending pod as soon as it has descended `hq.startingKit.podLandMinS` (the client's touchdown animation); `already_landed` once it is open.

market.acceptGuildOffer.summary: Crosses a docked Guild offer immediately through the W13 settlement path (NEAR-70, PROTOCOL market.acceptGuildOffer). A stale offerId is offer_expired.

market.cancelOrder.summary: Cancels one of the colony's open orders (owner only); its principal and fee reservations are released exactly once (W13-15).

market.placeOrder.summary: Places a limit order on the planet book `resource/price.token` at the colony's online Trade Hub (NEAR-60, NEAR-63). The sim checks the Hub, size, TTL and fee range and emits `marketOrderRequested`; the market module reserves funds and matches (W13-09).

market.release.summary: Module command: an order's reservation was released (cancel, TTL expiry, server-side reject or final settlement failure); the sim lowers `reservedInOrbit` and, on `rejected`, emits `marketOrderRejected` (W13-10).

market.reserve.summary: Module command from the market module: the order's reservation is held in the DB; the sim mirrors it in `reservedInOrbit` for the HUD (W13-10, SIMULATION market.*). No sim stock changes.

market.setHubFee.summary: Sets the stall fee the colony's Trade Hub charges buyers on fills where it is the maker's stall (D-44). Orders already open keep their pinned fee.

market.settled.summary: Module command after a trade batch is FINAL: updates the colony's in-orbit mirror and emits `tradeSettled` (and `feeEarned` for the stall) (W13-10, W13-13). No sim stock changes.

mercenary.spawn.summary: Spawns faction-mercenary recon at the poster hub edge until `endTick`. They cost the poster no supply.

moveGroup.summary: Orders owned units to distinct standable tiles around hex (q, r). pace "together" holds the group to its slowest member.

moveUnit.summary: Orders an owned unit (such as the HQ drone) to move to target hex (q, r).

placeBuilding.summary: Queues construction of a structure at (q, r) and auto-links any missing site preparation ops (UO-TF-03).

queueGoal.summary: Queues an HQ goal onto the colony goal queue (subject to HQ tier limit 2 / 3 / 5, UO-P §4.6).

raid.summary: Dispatches an army group to raid a target colony (`UO-W-08`, `UO-T-05`, W18-01..02).

reorderGoal.summary: Reorders a queued HQ goal within the colony goal queue (UO-P §4.6).

reorderTask.summary: Reorders a player-queued entry within its lane (UO-P §4.4, W02-13).

repair.summary: Enqueues or dispatches a repair job on a damaged player-owned structure or unit (UO-P §3.2, W03-03).

setAiEnabled.summary: Turns the colony AI (autonomous goal breakdown and rule-engine autopilot) on or off. Default off: bots only run explicit player commands.

setAutoTrade.summary: Sets per-resource autoTrade limits used by the director while the player is away (AW-13, NEAR-81).

setAutopilot.summary: Sets autopilot mode, away raids, the per-family away budget, and away mercenary hire.

setDirectorPolicy.summary: Patches the colony director policy (risk, preset, independent priorities, skill lists, pause).

setHarvestWeights.summary: Immediately updates the per-family harvest weights for standing Worker jobs (UO-L-01, W02-12).

setPlanetTime.summary: Configures the authoritative planetary solar time of day (0..24h), day length in real hours, and time scale multiplier.

setPriorities.summary: Sets the 5 canonical colony priority sliders (economy, expansion, defense, power, terraform; 0..100 step 10, SIM-R-02).

setRally.summary: Sets the rally hex (q, r) for a unit producer building or the colony (W07-10, W07-12).

setStance.summary: Sets the combat stance (hold, defend, hunt) for one or more owned combat units (UO-C-09, W07-12).

stopUnit.summary: Stops an owned unit: drops its current and queued commands and its route; queued auto work resumes after a short hold.

system.presence.summary: Marks a colony away or back. The sim does not read sockets.

system.spawnColony.summary: Spawns a colony drop pod at a free spawn slot with starting pod cargo (W01-09).

system.treasuryEffect.summary: Starts a planet treasury effect (meteor shield, terraform boost, or guild subsidy) until `untilTick`.

unitReserve.summary: Puts owned units in reserve (stops attack and production, keeps control slots) or deploys them again (activation recipe and delay apply).

account.created.summary: Named account created and linked to the player (F5).

alertPing.summary: Emitted when an alert ping occurs at hex (q, r) to drive the minimap ping ring (W04-01, W04-08).

awayBudgetExhausted.summary: Automated spend hit the away-session cap for one resource family (AW-20). Notified as away_budget_exhausted.

borderFrozen.summary: Emitted when territory border expansion freezes (e.g. beacon unpowered; W05-01).

bountyClaimed.summary: A colony or mercenary registered as a claimer of an open bounty (W22-02, NEAR-111).

bountyCompleted.summary: The bounty target was met. `claimer` is who the escrow pays (W22-02, NEAR-111).

bountyExpired.summary: A bounty passed `expiresAt` without being completed (W22-02, NEAR-110).

bountyPaid.summary: Escrow released the reward to the claimer (W22-02, NEAR-111).

bountyPosted.summary: A colony posted a bounty and the reward is held in escrow (W22-02, NEAR-110).

bountyRefunded.summary: An expired, cancelled, failed, or lost-building bounty returned its reward to the poster (W22-02, W22-21, NEAR-110).

brownout.summary: Emitted (debounced) when a colony power deficit causes brownout load shedding in `group` (W02-06, W02-17).

brownoutShed.summary: Emitted when per-component brownout shedding updates the list of shed entities on a grid component (W03-07, W03-15).

buildingCompleted.summary: Emitted when construction of a structure reaches 100 % completion (W01-16, W02-17, W02-28).

buildingDestroyed.summary: Emitted when a colony building reaches 0 HP, removing it and returning its footprint to Prepared ground (UO-TF-04, W07-02, W07-16).

cargoExported.summary: Colony stock was debited for export into orbital NEP-245 custody; triggers outbox mint on the server (W10-01, W10-05).

cargoImported.summary: Orbital cargo import requested or settled into colony stock (W10-01, W10-12).

cargoRefunded.summary: A failed orbital cargo export was refunded to colony stock (even above cap) or a failed import reservation was released (W10-01, W10-07).

colonyAway.summary: The colony has had no socket for AWAY_AFTER_S (CT-11, CT-12).

colonyBack.summary: The colony socket is back after an away period (CT-12).

colonyCritical.summary: The colony Hub is down and the elimination timer is running (UO-HQ-04, D-17).

colonyEliminated.summary: The colony is eliminated. Hard mode applies while the player is away (D-17, UO-HQ-04).

colonyFounded.summary: Emitted when a colony completes its Command Hub T1 and claims its initial territory (W01-17, W01-31).

deedMinted.summary: Emitted when a Colony Deed NFT is minted on colonyFounded (W20-01, W20-05).

deedSettled.summary: Emitted when a Colony Deed NFT is permanently sealed as Settled (W20-01, W20-15).

deedUpdated.summary: Emitted when a Colony Deed NFT metadata is updated after a milestone (W20-01, W20-07).

dev.pong.summary: Emitted by the sim when a dev.ping command is applied.

dev.tuned.summary: A balance override was tuned live (dev console `tune`); dataHash is the planet data hash after the change (D-35).

dev.warp.summary: Dev time warp changed: the planet now steps `k` engine steps per tick slot (effective value after the thread budget cap).

directorAction.summary: One director action moved to proposed, applied, rejected or superseded (AI-10).

directorAllowanceExhausted.summary: Director autoTrade stopped for one resource because the key allowance is spent or the key was revoked (CT-36, AW-20). Distinct from W09 awayBudgetExhausted.

directorOrderRequested.summary: The sim accepted a director autoTrade order after withinAutoTrade (NEAR-81). The market module re-checks, signs with the director key and places.

directorStatus.summary: Effective director risk, pause and remaining daily requests for one colony.

directorTrade.summary: The director filled an autoTrade while the player was away (F4). Digest text is built from this event.

energyCollapse.summary: Emitted when a colony remains in brownout for >= 30 s continuously (SIM §9, W02-06, W02-17).

faunaKilled.summary: Emitted when a fauna unit is killed by a colony, driving the Exterminator achievement family (W07-01, W07-27).

feeEarned.summary: The colony's Trade Hub earned a stall fee on a FINAL trade (realized, in the quote token); Port Authority progress input (W13-22, W13-27).

goalDone.summary: Emitted when an HQ goal reaches completion (UO-P §4.6).

goalProgress.summary: Emitted when an active HQ goal advances its completion progress (UO-P §4.6).

groundRevealed.summary: Emitted when a Clear / Break uncovers a buried deposit from the hidden subsurface (D-38).

guildOfferAcceptRequested.summary: The sim accepted market.acceptGuildOffer. The market module crosses that id against the NPC quote (W15-11). Server-only.

guildTradeSettled.summary: A Guild offer settled with the NPC account as counterparty (W15-11). Feeds Guild Contact progress.

hqLanded.summary: Emitted when the drop pod finishes its descent and deploys the HQ Commander drone (W01-09).

lightningStrike.summary: Emitted when a lightning bolt strikes a tile or 4-hex cluster, damaging buildings and overloading electricity (W05-01).

marketCancelRequested.summary: The sim accepted `market.cancelOrder`; the market module cancels the order (owner only) and releases its reservations once (W13-15). Server-only input.

marketHubFeeSet.summary: The colony's Trade Hub stall fee changed (applies to new orders only); the market module records it for new maker orders (W13-22).

marketOrderRejected.summary: The market module refused an order the sim had accepted (funds changed under lock, policy, limit); nothing stays reserved (W13-09).

marketOrderRequested.summary: The sim accepted `market.placeOrder` (Hub online, size, TTL, fee range); the market module creates the order, reserves funds and matches (W13-09). Server-only input.

marketSettlementFailed.summary: A trade the colony's order was part of definitely failed on settlement and the order ended with its reservation released; nothing changed hands: "Contract failed" toast (W13-24).

mercenaryArrived.summary: A hired mercenary squad spawned on the poster's territory (W22-02, NEAR-112).

mercenaryHired.summary: A mercenary squad was reserved on a defend-area bounty (W22-02, NEAR-112).

mercenaryLeft.summary: A mercenary squad left: the contract ended, the squad was wiped, or the hire was cancelled (W22-02, NEAR-112).

meteorImpact.summary: Emitted when a meteor impacts a tile or is blocked by a Hazard Shield (W05-01).

nestDestroyed.summary: Emitted when a fauna hive is destroyed, halting further spawns and wave rolls from that hive (UO-T-09, W07-15, W07-16, W07-27).

nightSurvived.summary: Emitted at dawn when a colony survives the full night without shedding beyond group 1 (SIM §9, W03-15).

obstacleRemoved.summary: Emitted when a Forest or Rock obstacle is removed via Clear or Break (Stone Mason progression, W01-13, W01-31); `overflow` is the capped-away yield.

powerOverload.summary: Emitted (debounced 600 ticks per pylon) when a pylon or Hub subtree demand exceeds its max load and sheds downstream consumers (W03-06).

powerSevered.summary: Emitted when destroying or demolishing a pylon/generator splits the colony power graph or disconnects buildings (W03-05).

prestigeCompleted.summary: A colony finished a prestige project (a non-tradable fact: no cash, no production multiplier); repeating it consumes its inputs again (W13-43).

projectileFired.summary: Emitted when a unit, turret, HQ, or fauna fires a projectile or instant beam (UO-C-01, UO-C-03, W07-03).

projectileImpact.summary: Emitted when a projectile or beam resolves at its aim point, applying primary and AoE damage (UO-C-01, UO-C-02, W07-03).

raidRepelled.summary: Emitted when an attacking fauna cohort is defeated or withdraws; unbreached is true if no colony building was destroyed (W07-16, W07-27).

raidStarted.summary: Emitted when a hive dispatches an attacking fauna cohort toward a colony (UO-T-04, W07-15, W07-16).

relay.submitted.summary: A gasless action was submitted through the relayer.

resourceProduced.summary: Aggregated per-60 s resource production batch emitted onto the event bus for Stockpile progression (W02-28).

resourceShortage.summary: Emitted when a resource drops below 5 % of its family cap with negative net flow over 60 s (SIM §9, W02-17).

resourceSpawned.summary: Emitted when a completed terraform `work` job spawns a new resource deposit on its hex (1 % roll, `TERRAFORM_RESOURCE_SPAWN`; tier in the `depositTier` tile layer).

stageReached.summary: Emitted when a colony reaches a new progression stage after trigger and dwell (or safety override, UO-P §6.2–§6.3).

stageUnlocked.summary: Emitted when a colony or player unlockStage advances, unlocking new buildable structures, units, and orders (UO-LC-02).

stormEnded.summary: Emitted when a planetary storm hazard ends (W05-01).

stormStarted.summary: Emitted when a planetary storm hazard starts (W05-01).

suggestionOffered.summary: Emitted when the stage tutorial or rule engine offers a suggestion instead of auto-queuing (UO-LC-04 / UO-LC-05).

territoryClaimed.summary: Emitted when a Territory Beacon or Command Hub claims tiles for a colony (W05-01).

territoryReverting.summary: Emitted when territory tiles begin reverting after beacon loss (W05-01).

tierUnlocked.summary: Emitted when an extractor unlocks T2 or T3 resource output via the Terraform % and local ring gate (D-34, W05-01, W05-34).

tilePrepared.summary: Emitted when one or more tiles reach the Prepared state via Grade (Groundbreaker progression, W01-13, W01-31).

tileStateChanged.summary: Emitted when a tile changes terrain class or prep state (e.g. Level, Fill, Reclaim, Irrigate, Seed, or building footprint revert; W05-01).

tradeSettled.summary: A trade the colony took part in is FINAL: "Contract signed: X for Y at <Stall> (n % fee)" (W13-24); Merchant progress input (W13-27).

treasuryEffectEnded.summary: A planet treasury effect reached `untilTick` and stopped (W22-01, NEAR-102).

treasuryEffectStarted.summary: A passed council project is active on the planet until `untilTick` (W22-01, NEAR-102).

treasuryProposalCreated.summary: A colony opened a planet-council proposal (W22-01, NEAR-102).

treasuryProposalFailed.summary: A treasury proposal was rejected or expired. No funds moved (W22-01, NEAR-102).

treasuryProposalPassed.summary: A treasury proposal passed and its cost left the DAO (W22-01, NEAR-102).

treasuryRejected.summary: A resource change a sim system expected to succeed (a terraform yield, a construction refund) was refused by the colony treasury (bad data); nothing moved.

treasuryVoteCast.summary: A council member voted on an open treasury proposal (W22-01, NEAR-102).

truceEnded.summary: Emitted when a truce expires on term or ends after its 10-minute cancellation notice (`UO-DIP-04`, W18-01, W18-14).

truceNotice.summary: Emitted when a partner initiates the 10-minute cancellation notice on an active truce (`UO-DIP-04`, W18-01, W18-14).

truceOffered.summary: Emitted when a colony proposes a fixed-term bilateral truce to a contacted neighbor (`UO-DIP-01..02`, W18-01, W18-11..12).

truceSigned.summary: Emitted when a truce offer is accepted and a bilateral truce becomes active (`UO-DIP-02..03`, W18-01, W18-12).

twisterStarted.summary: Emitted when a twister rises and begins moving in a random direction (W05).

underAttack.summary: Emitted when a player-owned entity takes hostile damage, debounced once per 60 s per colony (W07-16).

unitDestroyed.summary: Emitted when a non-HQ unit reaches 0 HP and is removed from the world (W07-02, W07-16).

unitProduced.summary: Emitted when a worker or combat unit completes production and spawns at its producer edge (W02-10, W02-17).

xp.levelUp.summary: The pilot reached a higher level.
